an3.129:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho āyasmā anuruddho …pe… bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an3.129:1.2: idāhaṃ bhante, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena yebhuyyena passāmi mātugāmaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjamānaṃ.
an3.129:1.3: katihi nu kho bhante, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti?
an3.129:2.1: tīhi kho anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
an3.129:2.3: idha anuruddha, mātugāmo pubbanhasamayaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati. majjhantikayaṃ samayaṃ issāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, sāyanhasamayaṃ kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati.
an3.129:2.4: imehi kho anuruddha, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti.
